readout_other: flow cytometry and imaging flow cytometry of brain macrophages (Cd9, phagocytosis, amyloid-beta); single-cell RNA sequencing; spatial transcriptomics; contrast-enhanced T1 MRI; passive cavitation detection (stable cavitation dose)
direction_notes: Brain macrophage modulation (Cd9+ DAM, phagocytosis) was largest with FUS-BBBO; FUS-N brain macrophages had no significant changes from naive. Neuronal excitation or inhibition was not assessed.

exposures.label: FUS + MB (250 kPa), FUS-BBBO (450 kPa) and FUS-N (2 MPa), bilateral hippocampus

timing.protocol_description: Each hippocampus was sonicated first for 10 s for cavitation baseline and then again for the experimental sonication; microbubbles (FUS + MB and FUS-BBBO) were injected intravenously between the two. Pulse length, PRF, duty cycle and experimental sonication duration are not stated.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: A single-element, spherical-segment FUS transducer (center frequency: 1.5 MHz, focal depth: 60 mm, radius: 30 mm Imasonic, France) that was driven by a function generator (Agilent, Palo Alto, CA, USA) through a 50-dB power amplifier (E&I, Rochester, NY, USA) was used to treat the bilateral hippocampus.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: A single-element, spherical-segment FUS transducer (center frequency: 1.5 MHz, focal depth: 60 mm, radius: 30 mm Imasonic, France) that was driven by a function generator (Agilent, Palo Alto, CA, USA) through a 50-dB power amplifier (E&I, Rochester, NY, USA) was used to treat the bilateral hippocampus.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.pressure: The FUS + MB, FUS-BBBO, and FUS-N mice were treated with 250, 450 and 2 MPa FUS, respectively.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Mice were treated on day 0 and sacrificed on day 5. Tissue was prepared for either flow cytometry selection and quantification of the brain macrophage or spatial transcriptomics.
source_quotes.n_subjects: For sequencing and validation experiments, n = 3/condition was chosen to maximize data while minimizing animal and monetary costs.
